> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The "Kampot Pepper Farm Premium Tour" at 'La Plantation' in southern [Cambodia](/destinations/cambodia/) offers a 5-hour agricultural and gourmet experience, highlighting Kampot pepper's PGI status and its use by Michelin-starred chefs. The tour includes a specialist guide (French/English), tasting of green, black, red, and white pepper, and a gourmet lunch featuring Kampot Pepper Crab or beef Lok Lak.
> *   This experience, open year-round with advance booking required, involves low physical demand (walking fields) and is best paired with a coastal stay in Kep or Kampot. Luxury SUV transfers are included, and a smart casual dress code is recommended.
> *   AGS provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury private transfers for this "pinnacle of luxury logistics" experience. This ensures a seamless integration into a high-standard itinerary, bypassing logistical friction.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Visit 'La Plantation' in southern Cambodia to discover why Kampot pepper is fiercely guarded by a Geographical Indication (PGI) status and revered by [Michelin](https://guide.michelin.com/us/en)-starred chefs globally.

## The Operator & Origin Story
During the French Protectorate, Kampot pepper was the absolute gold standard in Parisian kitchens. After decades of decline, eco-tourism operations like La Plantation have resurrected these historic farms, producing what is widely considered the finest, most aromatic pepper in the world through strict organic practices.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
A private car takes you from the coast into the lush, mountainous interior. Arriving at the sprawling estate, a specialist agricultural guide, fluent in French or English, leads you through the pepper vines. 

You will learn the intricate harvesting process and taste the distinct flavor profiles of green, black, red, and the elusive white pepper. The tour concludes at the plantation's stunning open-air restaurant, where you enjoy a gourmet lunch featuring the famous Kampot Pepper Crab or a beef Lok Lak, aggressively seasoned with fresh green peppercorns.

## Integrating Kampot’s Pepper Terroir With a Phnom Penh & Southern Coast Golf Journey
Situated in the fertile red-soil foothills of the Damrei (Elephant) Mountains between Kampot and Kep, **La Plantation** sits approximately 2.5 hours south of Phnom Penh via luxury private touring vehicle. On a multi-region Cambodian itinerary such as [The Khmer Kingdom Links](/tours/the-khmer-kingdom-links/), groups typically complete two championship rounds in the capital—playing the East and West layouts at [Vattanac Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/vattanac/) and Brian Curley’s 36-hole [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/)—before transitioning south for a coastal recovery leg en route to Kep or [Song Saa Private Island](/accommodations/cambodia/song-saa-private-island/).

Because the estate walk covers gently sloping organic pepper gardens shaded by coconut palms and traditional wooden stilt houses, physical exertion remains low, offering an ideal active-recovery break between tournament days in Phnom Penh and Siem Reap.

## Estate Tasting Protocol & Private Transfer Logistics
* **Protected Geographical Indication (PGI) Masterclass:** An English- or French-speaking agronomist walks your group through the four distinct harvests from the same *Piper nigrum* vine: young green peppercorns on the stem, sun-dried black pepper, tree-ripened red pepper, and soaked birds-eye white pepper.
* **Khmer Smokehouse Lunch in a Heritage Sala:** Seated inside an relocated 19th-century wooden Khmer house overlooking the plantation lake, guests dine on freshly harvested green Kampot pepper crab, tender beef *Lok Lak*, and roasted pineapple caramelized with red pepper syrup.
* **Direct Bag Transfer Between Capital & Coast:** When combining Phnom Penh golf at [Garden City Golf Club](/courses/cambodia/garden-city/) and [Vattanac Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/vattanac/) with a southern coastal retreat, Asia Golf Specialists transports golf travel covers in a dedicated luggage van so your passenger cabin remains spacious during the scenic drive through Kampot province.

faqs.q: How do golfers travel to La Plantation Kampot Pepper Farm from Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: La Plantation is a 2.5-hour chauffeured drive south of Phnom Penh via National Route 3. Most golf groups visit the estate as a full-day culinary excursion after playing Vattanac Golf Resort and Chhun On Golf Resort, or en route to Kep and the southern islands.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to witness the fresh green Kampot pepper harvest?
faqs.a: Fresh green Kampot pepper clusters are harvested from October through February, coinciding directly with Cambodia's prime dry golf season, while sun-dried black, red, and white PGI pepper tastings operate year-round.

faqs.q: Can we purchase vacuum-sealed PGI Kampot pepper to bring back to Australia?
faqs.a: Yes. La Plantation packages certified PGI black, red, white, and salted fermented peppercorns in export-sealed pouches with full origin traceability decals that clear Australian biosecurity inspections when declared.
